g.text: Drawing MFG-EX-DIE-01 | Part EX-DIE-01 — Connected 90 degree down-die body | Qty 1
Rev final-design-fabrication-closure-v0.8 | Units mm | Scale NTS, dimensions govern | Third-angle projection | source commit
Material: SCM440 QT + gas nitride | Process/finish: 6-face mill; gun drill/ream intersecting Ø8 channels; counterbore, drill/tap; stress relieve;
Overall: X 40.000 × Y 40.000 × Z 48.000 mm | general tolerance ISO 2768-m unless noted
Critical: 40x40x48; barrel face X40; Ø8 melt turn; Ø16.20 +0.05/0 x3 breaker seat; Ø12.00 +0.03/0 x14 insert seat; 4xØ4.5 + Ø8 recess PCD26; 2xØ3
H7 depth6 PCD26 at0/180 deg, position Ø0.02 to melt axis, selected Ø3 m6 dowels; heater Ø6.55 H7 through; 2xM3-6H depth6 at14 mm pitch for heater
flange; sensor Ø3.20 +0.05/0 blind12.00 +/-0.05; 2xM3-6H depth4 at10 mm pitch around sensor; face flatness0.03; deburr flow intersection; HOLD
GD&T/datums: A=barrel interface face; B=melt-channel axis; C=fastener-pattern centre plane; verify datum marking on supplier inspection report
Inspection: CMM/caliper against STEP and drawing; deburr and visual crack/warp inspection; pin-gauge channels/orifice; face flatness; shielded
Edges: remove burrs; break unspecified sharp edges C0.3–0.5. No unapproved material/tolerance substitution.
Artifact check: PASS only; fabrication HOLD pending full v0.8 gates. Physical NOT_RUN; machining USER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
